The widescreen fix of nfsu2_launcher.exe is a port of the NFSU2 Widescreen Fix (build 22042026) of the open-source
WidescreenFixesPack by ThirteenAG and contributors, https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack (MIT License,
LICENSE-MIT.txt).

What was taken from it:
  - the byte patterns that find the places to change in SPEED2.EXE (tools/mods/widescreen.py);
  - the formulas and options (mods_*.cpp): resolution list, HUD, field of view, rain droplets, video and front-end scaling, windowed
    modes, frame-time constants, camera, gamepad texts, NOS trail, console gamma, registry/settings handling, language;
  - the HUD placement table (NFSUnderground2.WidescreenFix.dat), which tools/mods/embed_hud_table.py turns into mods_hud_table.inc,
    compiled into the program.

What was NOT taken: the plug-in (.asi) itself. Nothing of the mod is loaded or read at run time, the game is never patched in
memory, and no file of the mod is shipped with the program; this notice and the license are.

The shader of the gamma pass is the mod's X360GammaApprox function, compiled at run time by the system's HLSL compiler.
third_party/widescreen/NFSUnderground2.WidescreenFix.dat is kept only as the source of the embedded table.
